Formulation
- The presentation is an acute, new-onset headache with features suggestive of migraine (photophobia, unilateral throbbing pain, variability in intensity). Stress at work is a potential precipitating factor discussed by the clinician. Family history of migraines in mother supports migrainous etiology. No red flags identified in the transcript. Plan focuses on symptomatic management with monitoring and escalation if red flags occur or symptoms persist.
